caption:
Medical debt and your credit report: it's complicated. 🏥

A federal CFPB rule to remove medical debt was vacated by a court in July 2025.

The big bureaus still say they leave off paid medical collections and medical debts under $500. Some states have their own limits.

Check your own reports and state rules.

Has medical debt ever shown on yours?
